description: Fictional cross-repository design coordination with independent owner reports.
setup: Use an isolated mind-forge consumer with the candidate toolkit, working configured CLI and document adapter. Materialize common_files plus the selected variant. Index and verify Article, Prompt and Thinking and synchronize Logbook state before launch.

Keep both design directories writable, except importer is read-only in case 42. Only the requested coordination writes are authorized. Capture complete read, write, skill invocations and runtime traces, including child operations. Capture before/after file bytes and permissions. Keep grading out of the subject workspace.

For the confirmed variant, seed the existing route confirmation and authorized directory scope from the fixture. Preflight case 28 needs a local catalog Git checkout for read-only branch and worktree inspection and the normal bound preflight observation record. For the returned variant, stage records/host-return.json as the independent host workflow return.

common_files.AGENTS.md:
# Fictional workspace
Use requested lb-* skills under .lbkit/skills and their linked contracts. Only this workspace is authorized. Written scope for each case is determined by its request. Use actual local mf and bin/lb. No network, dependency install, commit, publish, cleanup, business execution or extra agents. All data is fictional public material. documents.adapter is mind-forge. Read docs/document-guide.md and the mf-cli reference under .agents/skills/mf-cli.
common_files.docs/document-guide.md:
# Document guide
Logbook: projects/demo/docs/log.md; its Prompt: projects/demo/prompts/log.md; Thinking: projects/demo/thinking/log.md.
Resolve with mf -p projects/demo article show docs/log.md --json; index with mf -p projects/demo article index --json. Supported Logbook writes use bin/lb, current context token and preview. Authorized Thinking updates may use local edits. Preserve human content. Attributable returns are in records/. Use the normal document workflow for planning and progress.

version: 0.2.0
settings:
  documents:
    adapter: mind-forge
    project_root: projects
    mind_forge_guide: docs/document-guide.md
  limits:
    review_rounds: 3
  default_agent:
agents: {}
